tools.name: rescue_payload
tools.description: Repair a malformed JSON or API payload so it matches a required schema. Use when a request, webhook, or tool output was rejected for schema validation errors: wrong types, a null where an array or object belongs, a forbidden extra property, or mismatched keys between two APIs. Deterministic repairs

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "rescue_payload" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
